title: Trump floats meeting with Kim Jong Un while in Asia
description: The president is already scheduled to meet with several world leaders this week to discuss nuclear disarmament.

title: Lindsay Clancy to face a new trial in spring of 2027 over children's killing
description: A new trial is set in Massachusetts against Lindsay Clancy as prosecutors seek a criminal conviction over the killing of her three young children.

title: Biden looks backward, as the Democratic Party moves forward
description: His focus is now on litigating his place in history, not the future of the party he once led.

title: Midterm losses, Nvidia scandal weaken Trump as he faces Xi and Putin
description: As the president heads to Asia, his advisers are divided on key issues, and his diminished political influence may make other leaders wary of deals.

title: How Annie Andrews went from liberal gun-control activist to unlikely red-state senator
description: The South Carolina Democrat will now be colleagues with Republicans she parodied online.

title: The surprising new face of the MAHA-MAGA alliance: Stephen Miller
description: Health chief Robert F. Kennedy Jr. says the new White House chief of staff is even “more radical” than he is, encouraging MAHA supporters but worrying critics.

title: FAA ground stop still affecting thousands of flights. And, Trump meets Xi, Putin in Asia
description: U.S. Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy said that things could be back to normal at the end of Monday after an FAA ground stop disrupted flights. And, Trump heads to Asia for a high-profile trilateral summit.

title: Chris Van Hollen says he can beat Chuck Schumer. Here's his case
description: Sen. Chris Van Hollen told NPR's Morning Edition why he believes he can defeat Sen. Chuck Schumer and what he would change about Senate Democratic leadership.

title: Trump heads to Asia to meet with Xi and Putin amid Nvidia fallout
description: The trip to China marks Trump's second time this year, and comes as the president and his party faced widespread backlash from voters in the recent midterm elections.

title: Affordability was a key issue for midterm voters. It helped make childcare one, too
description: Childcare costs have surged, putting a major financial burden on U.S. families. Advocates say the subject once on the fringes of political debate became a major issue during the midterms.

title: Democratic strategists think Montana House race could hold the secret to future wins
description: Montana is sending a Democrat to the U.S. House for the first time in three decades. Many in the party think Sam Forstag's campaign may be a playbook for how Democrats can win again in rural America

title: After Senate win, Scott Colom says Democrats need to invest more in Mississippi
description: With his upset victory over Republican Sen. Cindy Hyde-Smith, Colom is set to become Mississippi’s first Democratic U.S. senator since John C. Stennis retired in 1989.

title: GOP glare on Lutnick grows amid Nvidia scandal
description: Former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang has agreed to testify before Congress in a closed-door meeting.

title: Chris Van Hollen says he has support in his bid to replace Chuck Schumer
description: Schumer has said he has the votes to win the race. Van Hollen said on “Fox News Sunday” that he has about 15 votes.

title: Trump blames Biden for FAA problems in first comments on nationwide ground stop
description: For more than a day and a half, Trump had been publicly mum on the travel chaos.

title: As Duffy seeks air traffic control upgrades, Democrats point to unspent funds
description: Democratic lawmakers questioned why Congress should approve more money when billions previously allocated for upgrades have yet to be spent.

title: Fresh off victory, Democrats gather with a warning: Don’t mess this up
description: Democrats at a convention in Denver tempered their big-win joy with concern that they could blow the opportunity.

title: How immigration policy plays out after Democrats sweep elections
description: Trump and his DHS secretary say they are open to working with Democrats on immigration policy. Stephen Miller as White House chief of staff might change that.

title: Pentagon prepares its own prosecution of general accused of leaking
description: Lt. Gen. Brett Sylvia now faces legal jeopardy on two fronts after allegations by Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth’s team were previously referred to the Justice Department.

title: In calling for an end to the Iran War, Vance walks a fine line with Trump
description: A rift is opening up between President Trump and Vice President Vance when it comes to the Iran War. NPR's Ayesha Rascoe talks to Susan Glasser, staff writer at the New Yorker.

title: Politics chat: Duffy calls for more funding, Democrats plans for accountability
description: Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy demands more money for the country's air travel control systems. Democrats plan for accountability, but not enough of them showed up for an impeachment vote.

title: Midterm voters ended the long-running GOP dominance in state legislatures
description: In several states, Democrats took control of legislatures that had been divided and they weakened GOP dominance in others. Issues on the agenda: More access to health care, new limits on school vouchers.

title: New Mexico wanted free childcare for all. This is what's worked — and what hasn't
description: A year ago in November, New Mexico became the first state to offer free childcare to every eligible family, regardless of income.

title: Majority of Americans disapprove of Trump’s construction projects, poll finds
description: The president’s efforts to remake Washington also face significant Republican opposition.

title: Chris Van Hollen revs up his public campaign to replace Chuck Schumer
description: The Democratic senator from Maryland launched a website and will hit the Sunday shows.
